title: Church Discipline
definition: Church discipline is the loving correction of sin in the Church for repentance, restoration, purity, and faithfulness to Christ.
summary: Discipline is not cruelty or control. It is a serious act of love meant to restore sinners and protect the Church.
christFocus: Christ cares about the holiness of His Church and calls His people to restore the wandering with humility.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Discipline is not cruelty or control. It is a serious act of love meant to restore sinners and protect the Church.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
